integrity: Complete analytic proof and exact-rational finite checks are included; finite enumeration is not claimed as proof for arbitrary n. The two original full texts cited as access risks were not represented as having been read.
scientific_limitations: Finite-length, two-color, equal positive initial masses, one-unit reinforcement. No assertion for unequal starting masses or more than two colors. The exact total-run distribution and conditional-uniformity ingredients are known; the reported contribution is the parameterwise monotone-likelihood-ratio ordering and its strict/equal adjacent steps. Closely relevant 2008 and 2018 full texts were inaccessible, leaving historical-priority uncertainty. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact likelihood-ratio ordering and parity plateaus for binary Pólya run counts
